result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The carousel clipping and the cut-off pizza card are expected and not reported. A few minor content and styling issues remain: a typo in the search placeholder, a time badge that overlaps the image edge, and low-contrast secondary text.

issues.description: The search placeholder has a typo: 'Restarants' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the string to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: On the 'Green Bowl Poké' card, the '15–25 min' badge sits at the image's bottom-left edge and extends slightly past the image's bottom boundary. Its overlap with the image looks inconsistent with the badges on the neighbouring cards.
issues.suggestion: Give the time badges the same inset from the image edges on every card.

issues.description: Secondary text (delivery fees, the '(500+)' rating count, and the gray search placeholder) is light gray on a white or light-gray background and has low contrast. The white text on the lighter green of the promo banner is also somewhat weak.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colors and the banner's green gradient to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).

issues.description: The heart (favorite) buttons on the cards are semi-transparent dark circles over busy imagery. On the ramen card the circle is nearly invisible against the dark image, so the control is hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Use a solid or lighter background for the favorite buttons so they stay visible on any image.
